acceptance_predicates.description: The public producer API accepts only a typed authenticated generation capability, not raw stream/evidence tuples.
The capability binds exact lifecycle protocol, generation, runner identity, and kernel peer identity before serving bytes.
Malformed input, timeout, zero evidence, identity mismatch, and unsupported protocol fail with typed bounded errors.
Stable ControlServer APIs remain unchanged and development mode does not add production authentication or key-management gates.
Exact hosted checks pass on merged PR #405.

definition_of_done: PR #405 is merged on protected main.
Independent review and all required hosted checks are green.
